text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi tends to push herself 
too hard and overdo it. I always keep an 
eye on her health, but—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Cool-down complete! That's all for 
today's menu!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I headed home relieved, but... A familiar 
pair of legs is sticking out of the 
flowerbed.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
? Trainer? Why are you in my room— Wait, 
huh?! This isn't my room?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi really does seem to be 
worn out. It might be best to reconsider 
her race schedule.
